name: knot_memory_store
description: Store a cognitive memory, learning, or architectural insight into the Knot Swarm Memory Palace (Embedded SQLite with CRDT & in-process vector indexing). Supports dual-pool architecture (node-local exploration scratchpad vs swarm-promoted shared memory) and artifact closet archiving.

artifact_content.description: Optional raw file content, code diff, or execution log to archive to artifact closet.

artifact_name.description: Optional name if archiving large payload / diff to artifact closet.

content.description: Detailed markdown explanation, rationale, or solution.

importance.description: Importance weight (default: 1.0; higher weights resist decay).

pool.description: Memory pool: 'shared' (swarm-promoted shared memory) or 'local'/'scratchpad' (node-local exploration scratchpad).

tags.description: Categorical tags for filtering and indexing.

title.description: Concise summary title of the memory nugget.
